rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both proclamations create a narrow exception from existing section 22 import restrictions for specially purposed articles, justify the exception by finding that it will not materially interfere with a Department of Agriculture program, declare that the earlier restrictions shall not apply, and condition entry or withdrawal from warehouse for consumption on presentation of written approval from the Secretary of Agriculture or a designated representative. C03 and C10 contain similar approval-conditioned exceptions, but their seed-import provisions are less closely aligned with the child's overall exemption structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the provisions of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], as amended, shall not be deemed to apply to Shmurah wheat flour
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the provisions of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], as amended, shall not apply to articles specified in Lists I and II thereof
shared_material.explanation: Both operative clauses exempt a narrowly defined class of imports from preexisting section 22 restrictions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: could not possibly render or tend to render ineffective, nor materially interfere with, the price-support program undertaken by the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.parent_excerpt: will not render, or tend to render, ineffective or materially interfere with any program or operation of the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C02's statutory noninterference finding to the wheat price-support program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Provided, That the written approval of the Secretary of Agriculture or his designated representative is presented at the time of entry or withdrawal from warehouse for consumption
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Provided, that ... the written approval of the Secretary of Agriculture or his designated representative is presented at the time of entry
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive shared administrative machinery imposed as the condition for the import exemption.

shared_material.child_excerpt: clarify the scope ... in this respect in order to simplify the administration of the proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: require modifications in the interest of simplification of enforcement
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the narrow exemption as a clarification or modification designed to simplify administration or enforcement without undermining the original restriction.
